level_1.description: A fixed elevated camera overlooks a small marked parking lot with two rows of parked cars, a roadside wooden barrier, sidewalks, grass islands and a background road beside a brick campus building and trees.

events.caption: A distant person in a gray-brown top and dark trousers walks right along the far campus path and down the paved approach to the road.
A distant person in a light top and pale blue trousers walks right along the far campus path and down the paved approach to the road.
A blue pickup enters from the right, drives left across the lot and turns into a parking space beside a maroon sedan.
A person in a dark gray top pushes open the near-side front door of the blue pickup from inside.
A person in a dark gray top and blue jeans steps out of the blue pickup through its near-side front doorway.
A person in a dark gray top pulls the near-side front door of the blue pickup shut while standing outside.
A person in a dark gray top and blue jeans walks diagonally down and left away from the blue pickup into the open lot.
A person in a purple top and light shorts pulls a dark wheeled suitcase diagonally right across the lot to the rear of the blue pickup.
A person in a dark gray top and blue jeans turns back and walks toward the near-side front door of the blue pickup.
A person in a gray-brown top and dark trousers walks diagonally across the background road from the far curb to the nearer sidewalk.
A person in a light top and pale blue trousers walks diagonally across the background road from the far curb to the nearer sidewalk.
A person in a dark gray top reopens the near-side front door of the blue pickup.
A person in a purple top lowers the tailgate of the blue pickup to a horizontal position.
A person in a dark gray top and blue jeans steps up through the open near-side front doorway and lowers into the pickup cab.
A person in a purple top pivots and brings the dark suitcase upright behind the lowered pickup tailgate.
A person inside the near-side front cabin pulls the blue pickup front door shut.
A person in a gray-brown top and dark trousers turns right along the nearer roadside sidewalk and exits at the right edge.
A person in a light top and pale blue trousers turns right along the nearer roadside sidewalk and exits at the right edge.
A person in a purple top lifts a dark suitcase over the lowered tailgate and pushes it into the blue pickup bed.
A distant person in dark clothing walks right along the far campus walkway, intermittently hidden by trees.
A person in a purple top raises the blue pickup tailgate and pushes it shut.
A person in a purple top and light shorts walks around the rear corner of the blue pickup toward its far-side cabin.
A person in a purple top reaches toward the far-side cab door of the blue pickup and swings it open.
A person in a purple top leans toward the open far-side cab doorway and lowers out of view behind the blue pickup.
The far-side cab door of the blue pickup swings closed.
The blue pickup reverses out of its parking space and curves backward across the aisle until its front points right.
The blue pickup drives forward to the right across the lot and exits through the right edge.
